该游戏的美术风格以及对细节上的拿捏确实值得一个好评 文字的掌控力以及穿插型叙述方式的出场表现（除了天空德尼特）也是相当不错，再加上制作组敢于用coc团这样的形式去做这么个游戏出来而且还是国内制作组 大环境所下来看真的是非常惊喜√配的上商店页面的特别好评，但其他方面却相当不尽人意 首先是检定方面 无论是coc还是dnd 充斥着大量的检定是一件普遍的事情 coc检定不可以多属于刻板印象 coc检定可以多 但( 什么时候该有检定方式 后果是什么 )这方面的平衡做的相当不行，检定在coc里是一种达成目的或者搜寻线索的一种方式 目前3个模组里 都有着一些检定失败会直接错失关键剧情的成分 而且没有修补手段或者另外达成该目的所需要的道具以及线索 再加上游戏拥有调查员不能反复进入已经完成的模组里的设定（←这个设定建议删除）无疑玩家在错失一些检定后会直接sl 也不会有再创建调查员再度进入模组的打算，再加上目前都是单人团 暂时携带队友的功能也没开放 数值并不全面的调查员很容易再次陷入上面这个循环 再来说说幸运值 这是一项能让玩家减少sl（sl属于非正常游玩）的设定，但却显得可有可无 可能是目前幸运值只能用来重骰或者[spoiler]通过神话物品施法[/spoiler]，在重骰方面 关键性的属性成长和特有剧情检定却无法使用幸运值重骰，再加上能重骰检定的点重骰过多消耗大量幸运值 玩家更多会选择直接sl 那这样幸运值的作用将显得可有可无 当然不排除后续会有更多幸运值的使用方式，就目前来讲是更像是没有完善过的系统模组 战斗方面人格解体给我的感觉更像是dnd，当我用dnd的数值规则思考方式去开卡的时候 我反而得到了更好的游戏体验（雾）该游戏拥有一定程度的战斗，战斗部分是普通人（还是一个人）面对神话生物甚至[spoiler]旧神分身[/spoiler][strike]最近的coc团已经玩这么大了吗[/strike] 当然合适的开卡依然可以轻松的击败这些战斗轮里的敌人，但也会直接让玩家产生什么问题都可以用战斗去解决就可以的思想（比如当面嘎模组1的教徒 模组2的男女仆 别的npc甚至毫无反应（？）） 最后数值方面，一边是过于谨慎 一边是大刀阔斧，比如金钱方面天降横财是+20 完成模组1的委托是+500 定金+500，摸走模组3的支票是+1000 ，[spoiler]模组2击败卡特+10000[/spoiler] 我直呼震惊 随之而来的是巨大的突兀感 就好像这个模组是故意为了你的幕间成长所准备的 ←幕间成长角色数值方面 普遍每模组间会有类似短休一样的12个时间点给你角色成长，收益双属性+5或者单属性+10的情况下 不能使用幸运值重骰下很可能会出现 付出100-2000不同的金币和4个时间点收获一个负面特性 而且里面还有一些特别离谱的负面特性比如 消极怠惰（精神充沛下直接三骰取最低）玩家除了收获巨大的挫败感还收获了什么呢 再本就不多的时间点下万一没有时间扭转特性 那么玩家还会收获撕卡的乐趣√[spoiler]当然在拥有天空德尼特的情况下依旧可以顶着上述负面继续游玩从而在下个幕间扭转，但本就不多的模组以及糟糕的重玩性导致玩家直接撕卡的可能性更大 又或者上述负面的情况下玩家没有拥有天空德尼特该神话物品 [/spoiler] 总体而言我更接近给差评而且不是好评，希望以后能有机会让这个差评变成沉睡√ 下面附一个自用人物卡 适合达到完美结局以及偏好调查探索的pl 因为d100+40 所以战斗也没问题 [spoiler] 体质：40 意志：70-80 智力：50 力量：20-30 敏捷：80 职业学者 交涉心理学50 感知40 隐匿50 观察50 博学神秘巧匠50 医学50 其他默认20点 可自行喜好更改 特性主要是双面人格降低精神充沛临界值10点以及获得真爱+15意志 其他可自行喜好更改 主要作用是通过职业模组下百科全书 针对小于等于50的技能值检定通过能+3精神的规则下（比如能工巧匠50技能值装备螺丝刀 制作物品双骰取高 成功制作精神变会+3）来让自己达到100的精神 那么超过精神充沛60临界的情况下 你的全属性检定会增加40的范围（例本身技能50会变90，而且百科全书写的是通过你技能小于等于50的检定，精神充沛只是给你提供40的加值 你本身依旧还是只有50的技能值 所以哪怕难度低到90 你也会依旧通过自身小于等于50的检定来增加精神值）再通过模组里，制作物品和投影神话物品增加属性，某种程度上你便是全属性90调查员[strike]唯有真理 永恒不灭[/strike] 直奔he吧星之钥√ [/spoiler]

好评别信，都是刷的，全是刷的，没一个讲真话的。差评估计也有托，全搁那扯蛋呢。 这就是个加了骰子的剧情回合制。 仙剑、古剑、轩辕剑、最终幻想、勇者斗恶龙、梦幻西游这些东西没玩过也该听过吧？啥时候变跑团了？ 我硬生生的隔这走了一个多小时剧情了。全是对话、回合战斗、还有调查捡垃圾，真的是垃圾，卖不出价也没卵用。 跑团！骰子！克苏鲁！Bad End！这个是真的绝，草泥马。 知道Bad End是什么不？读档重来！重走一次剧情！！！新冠没整死我，我差点隔这被气死。 多分支=两条道，往左走见我妈，往右走读档重来；两本书，左边的见你妈，右边的读档重来。 大量的自由选择=老废物主角在石头堆里发现了石头，我们来自由的判定一下你能不能捡起来吧？ 灵活多变的战斗=面对面三枪掷骰子全MISS，这你扔个鸡巴骰子？扔不出6枪口就对着自己吗？我扮演的是个傻逼吗？ 还有老废物主角的徒手攻击。一地石头你哪怕拿衣服包起来做个流星锤呢？ 抡不动石头是吧？就喜欢徒手打怪物是吧？空手就灵活多变是吧？千变万化全是拳头是吧？ 都一拳生万物、一拳化三清了，克苏鲁搁哪呢？为什么不去直接打死克苏鲁？ 剧情是出门买包烟都能听完9次的全家被神给日了的故事。 真的是跌宕起伏的纯剧情没任何玩法，我都不明白我搁那乱捡垃圾、是屁眼多大能塞进去几个？ 尤其这个煞笔战斗，回合像素战斗不做简明快，反而做的磨磨唧唧，简直就是用最完美的姿势展示最傻逼的缺点。 日狗了，真的是日狗了。 2022年底 我在这玩了 毫无自由度的像素版剧情回合制老游戏 ？？？？？ 我先不退款了，帮能看到的避雷吧，我踏马现在感觉要死了，被20年前玩GBA的我索命。

Update 12.2023: The English translation is still very bad, despite promises of professional team taking it over for months. I tried one of the newest modules, the circus one, and I couldn't even understand all the discussions that went between meta-characters before I even went into the adventure. I lost all will to try playing the rest. The controls were noticeably improved for controllers though. This game has really great premise and shows great promise. That said, for English speaking players I just can't recommend it at this point in time. In the future, when the stars align, it might become a must play. The biggest issue right now - the translation is really bad. The developer got "a professional team" now, and they are apparently redoing the translations. Some sentences looked like proper sentences now, but the most of the text is as bad as machine translation injected trough some software. Furthermore there are places, like character menu, which have Chinese text still on them. There's not much of that though. The punctuation of the sentences is also terrible, and often the sentence will be split into multiple chat bubbles. It seems like each part of the sentence was translated separately making it even harder to understand. In the past some of the text would be cut off in English version, but now it has proper scrolling of the text with right stick. It scrolls a bit too fast, and I'd rather have paging, but now I can read full event or clue without missing anything. The translation seems to have gotten better, as now I can understand more. They are also adding more modules, so the work goes on. In one of recent updates they fixed one of my biggest gripes with the game and massively upgraded the UI. Now it's more or less playable with a controller, no need to make wonky mappings that barely work. The modules could use a suggestion of what kind of explorer would be good. I ran one of the modules which had mandatory fight encounters that would just be unwinnable for my character. 2% chance to hit for 1-2 damage when there are 3 enemies with 10 health? And they kill my character in 1 turn. 1% to flee, despite having awesome related stat? With save scumming I managed to run away from one of those encounters, but the second one was too much. Especially the first battle was a bit strange, because I used sneaking, and succeeded, and suddenly I'm in a battle. Later in this scenario there was a selection of test. I choose a test, I succeeded, and I got game over. I don't know why there even is a test if I die regardless of the result. I've also ran into plenty of bugs, ranging from minor (the same event ran twice), to irritating (I was in combat while also in a cutscene at the same time. Not a combat which was a part of cutscene, but cutscene was going on, and behind it I could see the UI of combat that was also going on at the same time, but the event should have been ended at that point), to pretty much game breaking. You can opt out of a given scenario at any point, or restart it, so you can avoid most problems just by trying again. Overall the game is getting there. It's much better than when I bought it, and even much better than just 1 month ago when I last checked. Not good enough YET to get thumbs up, but close. Keep up the good work devs!

如果后续剧本还是天空的德尼特这种水平，那我建议还是早点开放创意工坊看看还能不能救一救。 战斗和探索的方式以及收益在游戏中的平衡我没啥意见，毕竟有人喜欢玩踢门，有人喜欢嘴遁。单就剧本方面说下游玩的时候很不喜欢的点。 1.把自己跑团经历做成剧本（×）把跑团的框架设置成剧本（√） 为什么大家都觉得谎言与欺诈优秀程度高于天空的德尼特？因为谎言的整个跑团架构是很完整的，玩家选择什么选项就对应什么剧情，这和在一个好kp的剧本下跑团一样很舒服。 但是天空给人的感觉就是，作者跑了个很不错的团，然后拍拍脑袋，“要不把这次经历改成游戏剧本，一定能火！”，玩家在游玩过程中基本上就纯属一个摇骰子的摄像头，一个莎夜的移动打手，反正玩家无论怎样探索，决定剧本走向的也就一个选项，大部分时候都是莎夜按着玩家的头把游戏进行下去，那我建议莎夜帮我把骰子也摇了吧。 2.亚南在剧本里玩我的卡（×）玩家的卡和玩家一心同体（√） 我不反感在剧本里有亚南这个角色，尽管序章和后续剧本里面对亚南这个角色的塑造都挺烂的，甚至不如爷爷给人的印象深刻，也许亚南是游戏制作者或者kp在游戏中自己的投影，制作者想给外神当下狗腿子，甚至想和娘化的外神美少女你侬我侬也没啥。玩家的卡当着亚南的手下也无所谓，谁没有个顶头上司呢。但设定成亚南与我的卡联系然后用我的卡推图就很蠢，大部分玩家会把角色卡当着是游戏中自身的投影，行为逻辑也是自己遇到事件会怎么做，而不是这个角色会如何，游戏的这个设计就完全膈应玩家，还有第一章救哚哚，我可以高几率失败，我可以适得其反，我也可以直接被撕卡，但KP不该让调查员无法丢这个骰子，然后把我的调查员晾在一边看亚南机械降神。 3.各式各样的挂名魔法少女（×）正儿八经的掉san怪（√） 别鼓捣你那破娘化啦，每次最终boss就给你来个挂名美少女，调查员连理智都不带掉的，压迫感和演出甚至不如道中怪。娘化就一两个就可以了。每次看着npc理智清空，一脸惊恐的喊着“他来了，我们都死定了！”，然后指着一旁的拿着武器翘着腿凌空而坐的长筒骑士靴配露肩黑色素胸衣的单马尾黑丝美少女不会尬吗？

儿时看过一本书，面对困境时，可以根据情节做出选择，再翻到对应的页码，就能将冒险继续下去，即使错选也可以快速翻到夹着手指的那页，直到happy end。因为这种体验十分新颖，于是有着比较深的印象，而这款《人格解体》就将这种体验又重现了出来。 虽然这么说，好像本游成了又一款经典，但实际重点其实在于本游的体量仅仅堪比儿童读物。 虽然本作最大的特色在于“游戏化跑团”，但实际玩起来其实就是更加随机的回合制rpg，或者其实就是美术好了的rpgmaker作品。虽然有各种随机判定，有着看似丰富的选择，但实际上都只在一条线上，殊途同归，仅有的自由度基本等于摆设。躲起来成功与否只决定打不打架，摸东西摸没摸到只决定等会打架手头上有啥，过多的战斗使得人总往战斗上倾斜，虽然其实也没其他地方可倾斜了，甚至每个故事想要好结局都要面对一个最终boss。嗯，更像回合制rpg了。那怎么办？杀过去吧，过五关斩六将。 每个模组，或者说每个故事都十分短平快，甚至大部分都没什么选择不同线路的可能。作为一款游戏，游玩时还可能略过不少内容，特别是在入门故事，人都没见几个说过什么，就roll死了古神，然后渲染主角的壮举了。如果要再谈回文字的话，就常见一般，也不会很特别。 还有另一个特色，就是娘化，其实没什么可指摘的，相反还说明美工很好。主要应该这么想：本来就是回合制里见人，又是像素风，画个怪物出来再可怕也有限，不如有这特色。到了演出也不会说怎样就正常水准。但是很怀疑这是产量低的罪魁祸首，很多画面素材就一次性。 当然也可以说未来可期，因为很多问题都是可以通过内容的填充完善的。不过，显然在ea版本制作组还有不少其他东西要做。 但目前不论是多人还是创意工坊看起来都不太可行，就目前几个故事，真联机多人了，20分钟速通不是梦，毕竟可交互的就那么几个。而创意工坊是需要创作者来做的，还面临美术素材的问题以及程序的问题，曾经mirror一代还做了其程序的maker给玩家，虽然玩家社区当时就欢呼了，但最后都没什么东西，万千模组只能存在于梦里了。追加：不过，若是以幕间故事而非本体模组的形式来创作，门槛几乎能降到纯文字剧本，似乎很有可行性。 成也风格化，败也风格化，该这么说吗。

玩后感觉自己产生了强烈的反社会倾向，甚至想去给这游戏打个好评让更多倒霉的原旨人玩到，能害一个是一个，这样我的痛苦就会被分摊了，嘻嘻嘻……嘻嘻嘻…… （以上均为口嗨不会实际发生） 目前打了2个模组，游玩体验可以说是差劲至极。虽说是克系游戏，但强烈不推荐克苏鲁爱好者来玩。说套皮克苏鲁都是过誉了，很奇怪为什么指出这个问题的人那么少，是我太苛刻了？原旨人快跑，美模人快跑，coj人可以酌情尝试但还不如去跑coj。非克苏鲁神话爱好者，喜欢像素游戏，不太计较粗糙的剧情，对本游戏期待较低，满足以上条件的玩家或许可以试一试。 以上是针对本游戏的自带模组的评价，如果未来创意工坊有出色的模组，我可能还会打开这个游戏。 目前市面上还没有其他coc模拟器竞品（桌游模拟器不算coc特攻）。游戏的美术可谓优秀，从画面到战斗动画都是比较顺眼的，音乐也算不错……夸到这里发现我夸不下去了，我脑子又开始发光了。 一大堆的问题我都有点不知道从何说起。 以跑团游戏为卖点宣传的，实际玩后发现它就是个带了骰子和角色卡系统的普通rpg游戏。 自由度低，极低，比coj还线。就这点已经可以和跑团说拜拜了。 骰子系统显得很多余，失败可以无脑燃运重骰。骰子影响的是什么，本来可以直接给的信息，本来可以直接得到的道具，需要过骰才给你。当然因为你肯定会燃运所以就是没区别。角色卡比起coc规则极大幅度被简化，角色的个性体现除了偶尔的选项基本就可以说是0。还很离谱的是游戏过程中竟然无法查看角色数值数据？ 一上来看到能制作很多道具还以为可以通过制作道具影响互动来改变故事线，事实证明完全是我想多了，这只是个华而不实的系统。 再说克味。不要说原作那种普通人面对未知强大力量的不知所措了，砍刀战神神挡杀神佛挡杀佛。很怀疑剧本负责人是不是通过百度百科了解的克苏鲁神话，整个游戏制作团队中就没有一个原旨人？拟人化，可以接受，但用类人的情感逻辑来诠释克苏鲁神祗，和常规的神话体系还有什么区别？我看本作中的神祗，感觉每一位都适合去约稿圈进行克苏鲁主题大设拍卖…… 撇开跑团和克苏鲁神话来谈谈游戏本身。把这个游戏看作普通像素rpg，仍然算不上佳作。讲故事全靠乱丢文件，故事本身又平庸。拿序章模组来说，剧情有极大的割裂，前一秒我是古堡大少爷，后一秒我普通男大学生，再一晃此处有剧透我甚至都不能说。每一部分都还没代入进去就已经结束了。 战斗也谈不上有趣，没有战略可言，全都只是走个过场（当然coc原本的战斗也不够有趣就是了……）。 模组内有很多可有可无的支线，其中大部分和主线毫无关系，最大的意义是送装备。可能开发者认为这样可以有提高自由度的感觉，但实际体验只是拖长游戏时间。 万众期待的游戏做成这样，让人忍不住叹气。即便游戏系统深度有限，也至少找个好作者来写模组吧。写模组本身就是需要水平和跑团经验的，并不是对克苏鲁神话有点兴趣就能写…… 明明有好游戏珠玉在前……此处很想踩一捧一，但是忍住了。 毕竟还在ea阶段，如果能更新好我当然是很想要一个改好评的机会……但整个游戏的系统已经比较完整了，猜想是没办法大改了。对这个游戏本身自带的模组不抱期望了，只希望未来能在创意工坊玩到优秀的模组。 我悟了，其实我买了个rpg maker。

[h1]被剥夺自由的游戏体验[/h1] 玩了《万物归一者》《谎言与欺骗》（撂下父女自己先跑了结果回不来了，be）《天空的德尼特》（血量只有十几，第一回合就被最终boss秒杀）等我再玩了后面的模组，再回来更新我的评论。 首先感谢制作组的用心。看到国内有独立制作的跑团游戏很开心。 游玩体验是：氛围感好，非常漂亮。系统太累赘。最重要的是没有选择的自由。 [h2]角色十分单薄[/h2] 我觉得官方的剧本写得都太平庸了，世界观大而无当。感觉就像是你描绘了一个巨大的华丽厅堂，但是却没把人物放进去，导致大多数介绍变成一块无用的背景贴图，读都不想读：“好了你别说了我知道了他是坏人。” OK就算你不是个游戏，你就打算写个小说，但拜托你的背景也是用来塑造人物的，背景解释不了任何主题，只有人物的激进选择才可以。在这方面你剧本写得真不如网文，你根本就没给人物设置阻碍。[b]死亡不是阻碍，除非你给死亡赋予了更深的意义，不然角色轻易就主动牺牲了，在读者这里根本没有任何分量。[/b]从这方面看，模组里没有一个角色是立体的。 [h2]再就是游戏性的方面。[/h2] [b]调查的时候我认真地读了各种报纸和线索，但最后发现我读不读都不关涉我如何选择，我就一个字都不想再读了。[/b]玩家首先关心的不是线索，而是角色如何行动。 再加上分支少，玩家拿到线索也并没有根据线索行动的自由，那整个游戏就只剩下打架和捡垃圾了。但这是被对面的数值怪逼着去捡垃圾，垃圾捡不够就be。 我觉得在开发游戏的时候，应该把工作首先放在人物行动上（而不是先画那个背景贴图一样的世界观），首先保证玩家有选择的自由：比如我可以信任这个npc而不是那个，都会有一个完整的结局，[b]而不是拿不完整的结局当做惩罚，这不是自由。[/b] 同理，[b]我调查或者不调查这个线索，都会有两种同样富有意义的反馈，但不能兼得。这才是真正的选择[/b]，如果我不调查就没有反馈，那这个选择题本身就是无意义的。 游戏的乐趣在于有趣的选择，但是在目前的模组里，我看不到什么选择的余地：要么交出道具要么死 ，这是被制作组按着头调查。这是真坐牢。 系统的累赘也是这个原因：我捡了一堆流血易燃道具，一路上敌人都很脆根本用不上，我留着打boss用。但最终boss出现的时候看到全debuff免疫，你知道我有多气愤吗？我被按着头捡的垃圾，到最后竟然给我负反馈！ [b]明明你小怪用拳头都能打死，你又要给boss加全免疫增益，那你为什么不直接删了这些流血易燃的机制！[/b]为什么又要欺骗玩家去捡垃圾！ 总而言之，问题不在于coj，就算是搞恋爱也好，至少给我选择的自由，A线让我和角色A在一起，B线让角色B陪着我，两个角色都一样丰满。[b]而不是要么同时抱走AB，要么是个不明不白的be。[/b] 克苏鲁变成白毛美少女也没关系，我们不搞克苏鲁也能做出好游戏。但你是个游戏，你得先好玩。 （抓住制作组）（用力摇晃）（大喊大叫） [b]你是个游戏，你给我选择的自由啊！！[/b]

I feel so bad about having to mark this one as "Not recommended", but the lack of translation polish (after the devs said they retranslated the entire 1st chapter) and the use of AI-generated assets are too much. [h3]To elaborate on my experience with the game:[/h3] - The game came out with very bad English translation. This itself was not an issue, as the devs promised to fix said translation ASAP. The June 5th fix came out, in which they said they retranslated the entire 1st chapter, and it was still very clearly not done by a professional. - Examples include multiple instances of strange syntax, broken grammar, and other word choices that make it clear something went wrong. Characters' pronouns got mixed up a lot towards the end of Act 1, in ways that I don't think is intentional and very much reminiscence of machine translation of chinese webnovels. For non-native or ESL speakers, inability to tell if the translation you're looking at is good or not is obviously unavoidable, and will get worse as more people use AI for translation. - Tangents aside, this is particularly bad for 2 reasons. The first is that the 1st Module is the tutorial and so leaves a lot of information unexplained or badly explained e.g. the fact that your first die in your dice roll is x10 for one. While familiarity with Call of Cthulhu and other BRP-based TTRPGs might help, it actually works against players in the second point. Namely, the repertoire of Lovecraft-inspired works have shared not just a thematic connection but also prose. HP Lovecraft's evocative language has been a real draw for a lot of people for the Mythos, and letting that be diminished by translation issues is a shame :( - Lastly, the use of AI-generated assets. As far as I can tell, AI is used in 2 places: character voices and a small "Seek answer" function (basically chatting with a specific NPC). [strike]While I would prefer all games I play to be completely free of AI assets, the fact that these are included in the game [i]without[/i] any warning or indication on the Store page is much more concerning. This effectively makes the players play a guessing game as to which parts of the game is AI-generated. The pixel art? The sprite animation? The dialogue splash art? I'd hate to think that the narrative itself is written by AI, given its high praises.[/strike] Edit: The devs have confirmed these are indeed the only 2 places where AI are used and put an appropriate warning on the store page, so I will cross them out of my review. Until the translation and AI-gen issues are addressed, I regrettably have to leave this review at "Not recommended". Edit: The translation improved dramatically in the Soladnit module, even though they just polished it and didn't even retranslate the entire thing. Very strange but I will take whatever improvements I can get. Please just ensure every translation is about as good as Soladnit or better. This is a solid 9/10 game buried in 5/10 translation issues!

This game is certainly one of a kind, in a good way. I was a bit unsure before I purchased the game, since some reviews were so hard on the translation, and while it is not the kind of translation you might be used to from bigger games, it's not that bad. Most of the translated parts are perfectly fine, but sometimes you might stumble on some untranslated dialogue, which can be a bit frustrating. Though this can be solved through image translation tools rather quickly and isn't more than a few sentences. Now to the game itself, it's a must-try for any Lovecraft and cosmic horror fans who like anime-style aesthetics. The game has an anthology style, with different Lovecraft-inspired stories; some might be more to your taste than others, but you will always feel the love for the genre and the different concepts in each one. (My favorite was Cursenday's Black Carnival. It's long, but I really liked the vibe and the characters.) You can achieve different endings in each module and it's really fun to try different choices or roleplay in character with the choices you make. In case you are ever stuck, there are English guides for the modules online. But I think it's more fun to go in blind and enjoy the atmosphere and the mystery. Another big plus? This game is not done, the developers will add more modules in the future and if that is not enough for you, the game enables fan-made modules. There are not that many that have an English translation, but there are enough to try out, and items and character mods can even be translated pretty well by yourself through editing the mod files with the help of Google Translate. Yeah, I did that for that Arknights character mod… Anyways, I recommend it. It's fun and I wish there were more games like this for me to stumble upon.

The game is good. So far, I've completed the first module. It was quite short but had some touching moments that I invite you to read yourself. I will update the review if anything major changes my view of the game. The concept, art, and story are quite charming. It's clear that the devs have put their hearts into writing the scenarios and designing the characters. The modular nature of the game is also extremely friendly for fan-made scenarios and mods, and these are aspects that the devs themselves highly encourage (though a lot of it is, understandably, in Chinese). The game itself runs smoothly without major errors. The gameplay was initially overwhelming with a ton of combat mechanics and items with minor uses, but it turned out fine. I haven't played enough to say how difficult the later modules are. There was a bug where I wiped my save after attempting to access the main menu a few hours into the tutorial, so I had to backtrack and replay that scenario from the start. While the English translation was readable, it had some obvious mistakes and errors and was likely translated using AI software. I simply turned off the AI-generated text-to-speech vocals, which were horrible; I don't think that vocals of that quality should be in any game. All in all, I'd say it's worth giving a go, especially if you can read Chinese. It's really cool to see games with unique combat systems that also encourage modding and fan scenarioes - it reminded me of Library of Ruina in this sense. The devs are also continuously updating the game and tweaking graphics and scenarios, so there's hope that the i18n will improve as well.

This game is a great example of great idea being tigthened by lack of the funds. And while it is pretty much unlikely that we will see more official modules, I think what currently available in this game is more than justifices its asking price, even with luckluster translation. Modules quality can vary, but overall all exploration modules are very much interesting playing first time when you have no idea what to expect, after which you can start hunting for true ending. Although getting true ending on first run can be unexpected disadvantage since it kind of kills desire to replay as all early endings are for the most part bad ones story wise. Doesn't change the fact that getting true ending in Carnival when I played it first time was quite satisfying My ranking for modules is as following: 1. Carnival - A veryh lengthy experience (2-4 evenings) with tons of locations to explore, not to mention artifacts to find. Story itself fumbles at the end a bit with pacing, but overall it is quite great mystery, although I do not recommend this module as first one since some battles can be challenging without extra partners or spell protection. Because this module is long and its difficulty raises only at th end, initial part probably would be a chore to repeat, but I still think playing it at least twice would be a good value due to it somewhat branching structure at the end. (Remember to have partners for spider goddess waifu battle) 2. Lies and Frauds - A very small and tight journey that you could probably finish in 1 evening. While it has a single intended ending, there is quite a nice alternative ending that is equally satisfying (Who doesn't like yummi stuff). Because it is so small it is the best module to learn game and its intended way of exploration through repeating the same module to reach true ending. 3. Welcome to Townsend - Another tight and small journey that really worth only 1 playthrough, but it is quite easy to miss out on true ending. It is kinda funny actually how easy it is to miss crucial component of true ending if you go along the story too fast, but as module is quite short, you should not have difficulty to replay it and reach true ending. A very minimal story comparing to other modules. There is single mystery to solve hence only 1 satisfying ending and much less enjoyable than Lies and Fraud 4. Soladnit - To my surprise, this moidule initial premise was quite interesting as you have to go through typical detective premise. But upon actual playthrough... You find most of it is quite boring really and somewhat counter intuitive since rather than detective I feel more like thief since I have to roam module scouting every corner for clue taking whatever my hand can reach. Its true ending boss is quite nice fight as it can screw you quite easily unless you built your character with something in mind. But otherwise there is no highlights to enjoy hence it is quite low on my personal ranking I don't think there is need to rank prologue or text modules. While prologue module is quite interesting as story, it is more of tutorial, so there is no real value to play again. Meanwhile text modules are... well they might be ok, but I don't really find value in playing it more than once, especially becauyse MTL makes it much harder to enjoy comparing to exploration modules TL;DR A nice trpg with ctulhu waifus
